sources.title: Cooling observations - synthetic demo
sources.text: In this synthetic example, elevated temperature across several channels prompts a review of cooling performance and operating heat load. Compare the recorded temperature trends with the nominal-cooler reference under comparable conditions. Temperature elevation alone does not identify a failed component.

sources.title: Temperature measurement review - synthetic demo
sources.text: Compare complete temperature cycles with a reference from supported, stable operating conditions. Changes in operating conditions can affect the comparison. For this demo, report differences in cycle mean temperature in degrees Celsius. An anomaly score describes a statistical deviation, not a failure probability.

sources.title: Temperature measurement review - synthetic demo
sources.text: This synthetic review compares temperature channels TS1, TS2, TS3, and TS4. Review missing values, abrupt changes, and whether channels change together. An unexpected reading in one sensor motivates a measurement-quality review. It does not establish that the sensor is defective.
